tags.name: air-unit
tags.description: An IDE-free test target. A broad run such as `BT --lane fast` runs it, unless the target is also `manual`.

tags.name: air-integration-ui
tags.description: A target that launches a real IDE, so it needs a GUI session. The CI `testTagFilters` excludes it.

tags.name: air-integration-headless
tags.description: A target that needs a real agent CLI, credentials, or the network. The CI `testTagFilters` excludes it.

tags.name: air-property
tags.description: A jetCheck property suite under tests/property. `BT --lane property` and a CI configuration of its own run it.

tags.name: air-slow
tags.description: An IDE-free target that sweeps many cases through the platform editor of an open project. Only `BT --lane fast` leaves it out. A directory run, `BT --lane all`, and the CI configurations run it.

tags.name: air-integration-ui-flow
tags.description: The generated UI-flow suites, `ui_lane_test`. `BT --lane ui` selects it.

tags.name: air-integration-gui-chat
tags.description: The ACP GUI-chat suites, `gui-chat_lane_test`. `BT --lane gui-chat` selects it.

tags.name: air-integration-ui-real
tags.description: The real-CLI flow suites, `ui-real_lane_test`. `BT --lane ui-real` selects it.

tags.name: air-integration-ui-live
tags.description: The live suites with real agents and real accounts, `ui-live_lane_test`. `BT --lane ui-live` selects it.

tags.name: air-integration-ui-perf
tags.description: The performance tests on the product heap, `ui-perf_lane_test`. `BT --lane ui-perf` selects it.

tags.name: air-integration-jcp
tags.description: The JCP cloud-task e2e, `jcp_test`. `BT --lane jcp` selects it.

lanes.name: fast
lanes.description: all Air unit tests, excluding UI, GUI-chat, headless integration, and the slow editor sweeps (the default loop)

lanes.name: property
lanes.description: the jetCheck property tests under tests/property

lanes.name: ui
lanes.description: deterministic UI-flow scenarios (launches a real IDE through the guest agent)

lanes.name: ui-real
lanes.description: only the real-CLI flow scenarios (a real pi can open an interactive auth callback, so no unattended lane run should ever trigger one)

lanes.name: ui-live
lanes.description: real agents on real accounts, explicit-only (spends billed turns; the target is manual, and no --changed, suites, shard or flake picks it; it runs only as vm.cmd run --lane ui-live in a Linux guest)

lanes.name: ui-perf
lanes.description: the Air performance tests on the product heap, explicit-only (each takes up to 90 min; the target is manual, and no --changed, suites, shard or flake picks it; a guest run is vm.cmd run --lane ui-perf)

lanes.name: jcp
lanes.description: the JCP cloud-task e2e on the local Docker stack with the AIP mock; IDE Starter launches its own IDE on the host: BT --lane jcp

lanes.name: gui-chat
lanes.description: ACP chat-flow, local-agent, and debug-tool-window scenarios

lanes.name: all
lanes.description: every Air target, including the slow integration lanes

lanes.name: claude
lanes.description: one real-agent target, with this lane's --test_env set applied
